purpose: Re-audit the exhausted three-session factor frontier after the Eastmoney core-profit-consistency terminal rejection and select at most one economically distinct mechanism available to the existing 3000-point Tushare authorization, without observing selected-candidate provider rows, factor values, prices, or returns.

official_permission_context.express_documented_candidate_meaning: total-assets growth rate versus the beginning of the year

candidate_review.reason: The standard documented permission requires 5000 points, above the current 3000-point account, and the ownership-crowding mechanism overlaps existing major-holder, holder-count, free-float and ownership-concentration branches. No additional purchase is justified.

The interface requires separate permission and supplies PDF URLs. Mining titles, text categories or announcement counts after the existing event-count frontier would add identity and multiple-testing risk rather than one frozen independent factor.

The documented output still lacks an announcement date, and segment labels do not expose a frozen cross-report identity or decomposition dimension. Joining a later financial-report date or interpreting segment text would not prove historical availability.

candidate_review.source: Tushare express earnings and profit fields
candidate_review.reason: Revenue/profit growth, earnings acceleration, forecast magnitude and profitability are already represented by terminal quarterly, forecast and formal-report mechanisms. A faster provider timestamp is not a new economic mechanism.

candidate_review.economic_mechanism: A lower total-assets growth rate versus the beginning of the year, newly disclosed in a performance express, is hypothesized to represent more disciplined balance-sheet expansion and less near-term investment overextension.
candidate_review.independence_reason: The candidate uses neither earnings growth nor margin, leverage level, book-to-market, free float, ownership, event count, order flow, industry breadth, cash conversion or OHLC path. It measures the pace of asset-base expansion rather than the balance-sheet liability ratio already rejected.

selected_mechanism.raw_units: percentage rate as documented by the provider
selected_mechanism.availability: first local trading session strictly after the displayed ann_date
selected_mechanism.duplicate_or_revision_policy: The documented standard output has no revision identity field; any duplicate stock-report-period key is fatal rather than selected or deduplicated.
selected_mechanism.absent_event_policy: missing; never zero, imputed or forward-filled beyond the frozen event age
